changeSet.author: jhipster
changeSet.sql: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_fy2026_it_awarded_pos_by_agency AS SELECT concat(coalesce(po.agency_acronym, ''), '|', coalesce(po.agency_name, '')) AS "Agency", sum(po.pototal) AS "Awarded" FROM purchase_order po JOIN it_commodity_code icc ON po.commoditycode ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND po.commoditycode::bigint = icc.code WHERE po.fiscalyear = 2026 GROUP BY po.agency_acronym, po.agency_name;
changeSet.rollback: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_fy2026_it_awarded_pos_by_agency;
